thread:
incident-bot: paging on-call SRE: unusual sustained RPM spike for model-family lyra-7b across us-west-2 (75% of family capacity). auto-alert threshold breached.

sre-ana: on-call here, looking. link to dashboard?

oncall-jay: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/board/lyra-7b -> 5m avg RPM up 3x. error rate creeping 1.8% (mostly 429).

infra-lee: probable hot-tenant shaping; seeing one tenant (tenant-cobalt) at high qps to lyra-7b. Could we soft-limit family RPM while we triage?

prod-maya: customer impact: a few freemium integrations might see timeouts. large paying customers on dedicated aren't affected. Need minimal disruption to latency-sensitive flows.

support-ethan: already getting tickets from customer-cobalt, saying "generation failures / timeouts". They're on an active campaign.

sre-ana: plan: apply a targeted per-model RPM cap for lyra-7b to reduce contention, plus raise TPM for dedicated variant to preserve throughput for sustained calls. Also enable tenant carveout for tenant-cobalt to keep them at reduced rate while we contact them.

oncall-jay: i can apply the RPM cap now. Suggest: lyra-7b RPM -> 4500 (was 12000), lyra-7b TPM reserve for dedicated -> keep at 20000, tenant-cobalt soft-window -> 600 RPM burst.

infra-lee: ack. preparing CLI. Using: `quotactl set --model lyra-7b --rpm 4500 --note "emergency family cap 2026-03-17"`

prod-maya: please annotate in incident ticket and post expected duration. I'll ping account team for tenant-cobalt to reduce job cadence.

support-ethan: ticket #INC-33421 created and linked. Customer notified with ETA 30m.

sre-ana: execute when ready. add rollback command: `quotactl set --model lyra-7b --rpm 12000 --note "rollback after mitigation"`

oncall-jay: running now: ```
> quotactl set --model lyra-7b --rpm 4500 --author oncall-jay --ticket INC-33421
Applied: lyra-7b.rpm = 4500
Propagation: 8s
```

infra-lee: propagation shows on all us-west-2 clusters. 5m RPM average dropped ~48%. 429s down to 0.6%.

sre-ana: good. next step: enable tenant carveout rule to cap tenant-cobalt to 600 RPM so they don't spiky-slam the family. `quotactl tenant-set --tenant tenant-cobalt --model lyra-7b --rpm 600 --soft=true`

oncall-jay: carveout applied. Noting: soft=true => throttled with 429s but priority preserved for account limits.

prod-maya: any functional degradations to features? We might need to disable funcall for lyra-7b temporarily if errors persist.

sre-ana: not yet. Keep funcall enabled. We'll evaluate after 15 mins. If error rate rises above 1% or latency P95 > 1.8s, we consider suspending funcall on family.

support-ethan: update: customer-cobalt acknowledged receipt and throttled their job runner by 70% as requested.

infra-lee: also bumped prefetch cache TTL for lyra-7b to reduce cold starts: `cachectl set lyra-7b --ttl 600` — minor perf gains observed.

sre-ana: monitoring: latency P95 back to baseline in 3 out of 4 zones, errors trending down. Marking immediate mitigation as successful.

prod-maya: please write short postmortem note & include model quota changes, tenant carveout, and contact timeline. I'll follow up on customer compensation if their campaign impacted.

oncall-jay: handoff notes for next on-call: 
- mitigation actions taken: family RPM lowered to 4500 (applied 1765401258)
- tenant-cobalt soft carveout set to 600 RPM (applied 1765401284)
- cache TTL increased to 600s for lyra-7b
- rollback command: `quotactl set --model lyra-7b --rpm 12000 --author oncall-jay --ticket INC-33421` (use after confirmation of sustained stability)
- contact: prod-maya and support-ethan on customer comms

sre-ana: tagging it for follow-up runbook update: add a section for "lyra-7b rapid-family-cap" and explicit funcall-suspend threshold.

oncall-jay: assigning pager to infra-lee for next 1hr passive watch. I'm wrapping and handing to next oncall.

incident-bot: incident updated: severity lowered to SEV-3. Link to incident: https://incident.redwood/INC-33421

support-ethan: final note: customers with errors: tenant-cobalt (notified), tenant-omega (brief spikes but auto-recovered). All tickets created.

prod-maya: thanks everyone. please add any residual notes in INC-33421 and close after 24h stable.

sre-ana: handoff complete — leaving a short runbook item and will join postmortem sync at 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:
